director_decisions.pelvis: No pelvis bone. Torso is a root child, pivoting at the native lower-back/pelvis joint.
director_decisions.collar: Torso child at native head joint (neck base); head bows independently.
director_decisions.seer_skirts: Torso children at each native hip/waist joint above its half.
director_decisions.seer_feet: Root children at their own native ankle joints; independent of torso lean.
director_decisions.seer_staff: Shaft is a far-hand child at grip. Crystal is always a shaft child at the shaft tip, including death.
director_decisions.thrall_thighs: Root children at native hip joints; shins and feet retain the native limb chains.
director_decisions.thrall_loincloth: Torso child at native pelvis/waist joint, following hunch and death.
